Content Strategists are responsible for managing client accounts and executing content strategies that align with SEO/GEO goals. They oversee content creation, optimization, and performance tracking for assigned accounts. Content Strategists are expected to be proactive in managing client relationships, ensuring that strategies are executed effectively, and delivering high-quality content that meets client objectives.

• Content Creation & Editing : Write, edit, and deliver high-quality content for various formats (blogs, landing pages, etc.), ensuring it meets client needs and SEO/GEO requirements.

• AI-Driven Content Production : Leverage AI tools and workflows to help produce content at scale, while maintaining quality, brand voice, and SEO/GEO standards. Contribute to refining and building out internal AI-assisted content systems and processes.

• Team Collaboration : Work with internal teams to execute integrated content strategies. Ensure content is optimized for both SEO/GEO and user experience.

• Proven ability to develop and guide content production across multiple client accounts, ensuring alignment with brand voice, search intent, and strategic goals.

title: Software Engineer, Desktop
description:
About A1
There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks that are not AI-native. Our mission is to build a proactive smart assistant for everyday users to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal prompting.
Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. The system must handle multi-step reasoning, interact with external tools, and remain reliable despite non-deterministic model behavior. Our objective is to help users complete tasks daily enjoyable with over ~90%* reduced time.
Role
You will own how this system behaves on desktop environments. Your work focuses on reliability, performance, and real-time behavior in production desktop applications.
Focus

• Build and maintain cross-platform desktop applications using Electron.

• Design responsive and scalable UIs for real-time collaboration.

• Implement desktop-specific functionality including file system access, native notifications, auto-updates, and deep linking.

• Integrate AI-powered features (chat, agents, AI assistance) via backend APIs.

• Optimize startup time, memory usage, and runtime performance.

• Profile and reduce Electron overhead.

• Manage large local state and message history efficiently.

• Ensure smooth real-time updates (messages, typing indicators, presence).

• Maintain stability across macOS and Windows environments.

Ideal Experiences

• Proven software engineering experience.

• Hands-on experience building production Electron applications.

• Strong proficiency in JavaScript and TypeScript.

• Experience with React or similar UI frameworks.

• Solid understanding of the desktop application lifecycle.

• Experience with IPC communication.

• Experience working with local storage (SQLite, IndexedDB, filesystem).

• Experience with WebSockets or other real-time transport mechanisms.

• Strong debugging and performance profiling skills.

• Familiarity with native OS behaviors on macOS or Windows.

Tech Stack

• Electron

• Node.js

• Typescript

• SQl & noSQL

How We Work
The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product
Interview process
If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.
Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.
We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

title: Product Manager
description:
PRODUCT MANAGER

ABOUT US

Our mission: Eradicate health disparities by empowering the teams who care for underserved families.

BridgeHealthAI partners with Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs) and community organizations to ensure every patient gets the care and benefits they deserve without drowning care teams in paperwork.

Our platform automates high-friction tasks like outreach, insurance verification, eligibility checks, follow-ups, referrals, and scheduling. With modern AI and automation, we help teams close care gaps faster, protect revenue, reduce administrative burden, and stay focused on patients.

Born out of Harvard and MIT and backed by Pear VC, Flare Capital, and Glen Tullman (founder of Livongo), BridgeHealthAI is a fast-growing, seed-stage company trusted by leading community health centers. We are purpose-built for the safety net, helping clinics scale access, reduce burnout, and deliver equitable care for the 30M+ patients served by FQHCs each year.

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Product Manager with 5+ years of product management experience and meaningful experience in healthcare or health tech to help us turn complex healthcare operations into simple, scalable products.

This is a highly hands-on, customer-facing product role. You'll work directly with health center executives, frontline teams, engineers, operations, and the founders to deeply understand problems, identify what we should build, and drive products from discovery through launch and iteration.

You'll be in the room with our customers. You'll lead working sessions, understand how their workflows operate today, identify where things break down, and work alongside them to design better ways of working. You'll turn those conversations into product ideas and clear product direction, bring concepts back to customers for feedback, and partner closely with engineering to bring the best solutions to life.

Our customers operate in complex environments where workflows often span patients, staff, payers, EHRs, external systems, phone calls, spreadsheets, and manual follow-up. Your job is to make that complexity feel simple.

You won't manage a backlog from a distance. You'll talk to users, map workflows, make product decisions, write clear requirements, test ideas, and stay close to customers after launch to make sure what we build actually works.

You'll have significant ownership over our product as we scale from high-value workflows into a broader platform for healthcare administrative automation.

- Own products and workflows end-to-end, from customer discovery and problem definition through development, launch, measurement, and iteration.

- Lead product conversations directly with customers, including healthcare executives, operational leaders, and frontline staff.

- Facilitate ambiguous customer conversations and create clarity. Ask the right questions, surface the real problem, align on the desired future state, and determine what the product team should do next.

- Turn customer conversations into scalable product direction, separating individual feature requests from broader problems and identifying patterns across customers.

- Prototype and test ideas quickly. Put concepts in front of users, gather feedback, and iterate before and after launch.

- Translate complex healthcare operations into intuitive products that reduce administrative burden and make it easier for teams to get work done.

- Partner closely with engineering to translate customer and business needs into clear product requirements and make thoughtful tradeoffs around scope, usability, speed, and reliability.

- Map current-state and future-state workflows, including the people, systems, decisions, handoffs, and exceptions involved.

title: Research Scientist, Computational Enzymology
description: About us We're reverse-engineering the origin of life - one of the great unsolved problems in science, and one we think AI finally makes tractable. Understanding this transition, from geochemistry to biochemistry, is what will let us orchestrate molecular networks and build systems that are more capable, adaptive, and efficient. If we succeed, the applications are vast: catalysis, green synthesis, ab initio synthetic biology, programmable matter. Understanding and harnessing these processes could let ten billion of us thrive on this planet - and let life keep evolving beyond it. We're a small, diverse team of AI engineers, computational scientists, and bench scientists. We hold ourselves to the rigor of a research institute, but we ship like an engineering firm. title: Wargaming Research & Systems Analyst — Red Cell Lead
locationText: Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates; London, England, United Kingdom
tags: Maritime & Maneuver Dominance : Maneuver Dominance Engineering : MD - Advanced Capabilities
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

At Anduril, we are developing unmanned systems for subsurface, surface, land, and air domains that will leverage unsupervised autonomy for the delivery of multi-mission capability to our customers. In addition to the physical systems being produced, Anduril is providing training and experimentation services to our partners and customers. These projects require Warfighting Systems Analysts who can connect operational needs to system architecture, technical performance, integration choices, and mission-level outcomes. We are looking for our next Lead Warfighting Systems Analyst to join our rapidly growing team in Abu Dhabi, UAE . Initial hiring will be in London, UK and the candidate will relocate upon initial completion of the simulation center.

The Lead Warfighting Systems Analyst is responsible for producing, iterating, and supporting Modeling, Simulation, and Analysis (M&SA) including wargaming and experimentation for Anduril products. This has a three-fold purpose: Train the customer in Anduril capabilities, conduct internal analysis to support the iterative improvement of current and future products, and learn the specific customers’ needs to ensure we produce the right product for the right reasons. The Lead Warfighter Systems Analyst will be the first hire and lead role in an extremely Agile team of wargaming analysts who will be the plank owners of a new simulation center being built in the UAE.

This role is ideal for individuals who can reason across military operations and technical systems, evaluate performance tradeoffs, develop and deploy scenarios with Python and YAML, and communicate how system design decisions affect operational utility.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Leverage high-end models and simulations, including Anduril's Lattice Mission Simulation (MissionSim) to conduct simulation, experimentation, and training

• Develop scenarios based on customer needs to demonstrate capabilities

• Support engineering and product teams by evaluating how platform, payload, autonomy, sensor, effector, communications, navigation, or C2 choices affect mission outcomes

• Design, execute, and analyze tactical (engagement-level and mission-level) analysis and wargames to assess autonomous system capabilities and refine tactics

• Develop physics-based models and relevant operational scenarios, with an emphasis on modeling red and blue force systems and tactics

• Assess system-of-systems interactions, integration risks, dependencies, constraints, and mission impacts

• Lead the warfighting capability analysts to ensure system analysis remains grounded in real operational problems and customer needs

• Collaborate with engineering and business development teams to demonstrate Anduril's capabilities and value proposition through rigorous, data-driven analysis

 

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Currently possess and be able to maintain an active country specific Secret security clearance

• 7+ years of experience in Operations Research, Systems Analysis (ORSA), systems engineering, mission engineering, test and evaluation, or a related technical-operational discipline

• Experience with tactical experiments and wargaming design, including scenario development, data analytics, and trade-space analysis

title: Marketing AI Intern
description:
As our Marketing AI Intern , you’ll help the marketing team work faster and smarter with AI. You’ll sit with the team and build the things that remove busywork - custom AI agents, automated workflows, and small internal tools. You don’t need to have done this job before. You need to be technical enough to pick it up quickly, and driven enough to keep going when the documentation runs out. We’ll teach you the marketing side. You will report to the Sr. Director, Marketing Operations.
This is a 4-month, full-time, contract role. You’ll be embedded with the marketing team from day one, working through a real backlog of AI projects on a daily cadence. This is a build role, not a shadowing role - expect to ship things people actually use.
This is a remote role that can be based anywhere in the US.
What You’ll Do (aka Responsibilities)

Build AI Agents Build and improve custom AI agents and agentic workflows (using Claude, OpenAI GPTs, and similar platforms) that help specific marketing roles - field marketing, content, digital marketing, and marketing operations. You’ll collect feedback from the team and keep iterating.

Workflow Automation Learn tools like Zapier, MCP connectors, and LLM integrations, then use them to wire AI into our existing martech stack (Marketo, Salesforce, 6sense, and more), replacing manual steps with automated ones.

MCP Connectors Help build and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors across our marketing applications. MCP is how we give AI tools secure, structured access to our systems - we’ll teach you how it works, and you’ll own pieces of it as you ramp.

Prompt Engineering Help build a shared library of prompts, skills, and brand voice frameworks so AI output stays consistent across the team, and help document the guardrails for how we use these tools.

Backlog Delivery Work through projects from marketing’s AI backlog and ship something useful most weeks. Momentum and follow-through matter more here than polish.

Enablement & Office Hours Help run office hours and walk teammates through new tools. A lot of the value in this role comes from sitting next to someone and unblocking them.

Sharing What Works Document and share what you learn - what worked, what didn’t, and what’s worth trying next - so the whole team gets better, not just you.

Tool Evaluation Explore and evaluate AI tools and give an honest read on whether they’re worth adopting, keeping our data security and integration standards in mind.

Stretch Projects If you’re moving fast, there’s room to go deeper - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), multi-modal AI, or more ambitious agent designs. (Nice to have, not expected.)

What You'll Bring (aka Education, Experience, Skills)

• Pursuing or recently completed a degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a similarly technical field - or able to show equivalent self-taught technical ability

• Hands-on curiosity with LLMs like Claude, GPT, or Gemini - you’ve pushed past casual chatbot use and actually tried to build something with them

The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. Today it's absorbing intermittent supply from grid scale solar and wind, alongside dynamic demand from EVs, heat pumps, and home batteries. The missing piece is software that can connect and orchestrate these devices at scale.

Enode https://enode.com provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. Our Connect https://enode.com/connect API gives energy companies a single integration to 1000+ devices across 80+ brands. Our optimisation https://enode.com/optimize tooling gives energy companies the building blocks to manage those devices locally - think smart charging for EVs. Our Flex https://enode.com/flex product turns those connected devices into a flexible, controllable asset for energy companies.

Our customers are energy retailers, utilities, and traders building the next generation of energy services. We're backed by Y Combinator, Lowercarbon Capital, and Creandum.

The decisions made now will shape how the energy system gets built. We're looking for people who take ownership, move fast, and care deeply about the role technology can play in the energy transition.

AI is how a team our size keeps rewiring the way we work, fast enough to match what our mission demands. We look for people who reach for AI as a reflex and who can drop a habit that used to work. You'll report to Enode's VP of Revenue, who leads sales, customer success, customer engineering, marketing and partnerships. You'll join a team of account executives, working alongside customer success on the accounts you win and directly with our customer engineering managers through technical validation on every deal.

You will carry a number and shape how we sell at the same time. There is more room to influence the motion here than at a company where it is already settled, and more expectation that you will use it.

Doctolib is looking for you to join us as a Senior AI Specialist (x/f/m) at our Berlin location, starting as soon as possible.

Doctolib is becoming an AI-native company. We are redesigning the way we work, workflow by workflow, and are looking for people who will not only support this transformation, but actively build it. As a Senior AI Specialist , you will be the technical builder and AI Ops Owner behind AI-powered productivity for our Operations and Customer Success teams.

 

You will work in founder and product mode : you will own a workflow end to end, from context and agent design to evaluation, and continuously take it to a higher level of automation. Our ambition is to move away from manual case-by-case work towards workflows that run largely autonomously while maintaining a high quality bar. In this way, you will contribute directly to our mission of improving healthcare for everyone.

Your Responsibilities

• Redesign workflows rather than simply automating them:  You analyze the most critical Operations and Customer Success workflows, break down time-consuming processes that require limited judgment, and transform them through the use of AI agents. You set clear objectives for autonomy and quality, and continuously develop them further.

• Build and operate AI agents as products:  You develop and manage agents on platforms such as Dust or Claude. Each agent is deployed to production with a defined baseline and relevant metrics such as benefit, usage, and scalability.

• Knowledge and context management:  You deliberately curate the context agents need, from templates to core data. The guiding principle is quality over quantity. You ensure that knowledge sources in Confluence, Drive, or Salesforce are always up to date and well structured.

• Evaluation and quality assurance:  You define quality standards and establish evaluation routines to identify and address weaknesses such as hallucinations or prompt drift at an early stage. You continuously optimize prompts through systematic user feedback and A/B testing.

• CRM and data integration:  You own the interfaces between CRM systems such as Salesforce and our AI platforms. You automate data flows and work closely with IT to unlock new, valuable data sources for our agents.

• Central interface and enablement:  You translate business requirements into technical solutions and bring together stakeholders from Leadership, IT, and Product. You strengthen the team’s AI fluency in the areas of context, agent management, and evaluation.

• Impact and measurement:  Rather than inventing new KPIs, you make the success of AI measurable using existing metrics such as time, quality, and cost, and use these insights to guide the next steps in scaling.

Your Profile

Since production-ready AI workflows and agent technologies are still relatively new, years of market experience are rare. We therefore deliberately prioritize potential over years of experience alone . What matters to us is your ability to learn quickly, your strong product mindset, and your judgment. If you are passionate about this field and bring the necessary skills, we would be delighted to hear from you, even if your profile does not perfectly cover every single aspect.

• Learning speed and a production mindset:  You have taught yourself a new technical field from scratch and built something real that people actually used. You can describe precisely what went wrong, such as hallucinations, prompt drift, outdated data, or costs, and how you solved it.

• An instinct for evaluation:  You do not rely on something merely “looking good”. You define a quality bar and measure against it. For you, automation and quality go hand in hand.

title: Senior PLM Developer

Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril ’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM
ArsenalOS is Anduril 's unified production systems platform - the digital backbone for our manufacturing operations spanning PLM, MES, WMS, and supply chain systems. We're building modern, integrated solutions that enable us to scale hardware production with software velocity.

In the ArsenalOS future state, users will not experience the lifecycle as disconnected silos. A design change will propagate into the bill of materials, planning systems, work instructions, quality workflows, and supplier-facing systems with minimal lag. A production issue will immediately surface to the teams responsible for design, manufacturing, supplier performance, and sustainment. Field signals will flow upstream fast enough to influence the next build of a product, not the next quarterly review. ArsenalOS will turn the Build Chain into a continuous learning system.
ABOUT THE JOB
We are looking for a experienced Senior PLM Software Engineer with strong Teamcenter expertise to join the ArsenalOS PLM team. As a PLM Software Engineer on ArsenalOS, you will be architecting and implementing mission-critical Teamcenter customizations, integrations, and solutions that enable engineering teams to design, manage, and deliver complex hardware products at scale.
This is not a traditional "maintain legacy PLM" role. We want builders. As a member of ArsenalOS PLM, you will help architect and develop next-generation Engineering Backbone from the ground up - integrating CAD, ERP, MES, manufacturing, and engineering systems into scalable modern platforms. You'll be developing custom ITK services, SOA integrations, Active Workspace customizations, and enterprise integrations that serve engineering teams across multiple product lines. We spend time with engineering teams, then provide solutions for the challenges they face managing product data, BOMs, change management, and configuration management.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on, deeply technical Teamcenter Software Engineer who thrives in fast-moving, greenfield environments. You combine strong software engineering foundations with Teamcenter expertise, while avoiding the "this is how PLM has always been done" mindset. We value curiosity, speed, ownership, clean architecture, and pragmatic execution over heavyweight process or legacy baggage.
You should be equally comfortable with:

• Teamcenter internals and workflows

• APIs and distributed systems

• CI/CD and cloud-native architecture

• Integration patterns and event-driven services

• Data modeling and scalable engineering platforms

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own and deliver complex Teamcenter customizations and integrations for ArsenalOS PLM (ITK, SOA, BMIDE, Active Workspace)

• Build high-performance integrations between Teamcenter and other ArsenalOS systems (ERP, MES, change management, requirements management, CAD)

• Design and implement scalable data models, business logic, and workflow solutions while minimizing upgrade friction

• Contribute to improving the platform observability (Datadog, etc) and reliability

• Set the bar for engineering excellence - raise standards through opinionated technical decisions, architectural guidance, and high-quality code contributions

title: Learning Content Specialist
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Avid Learning is seeking a Learning Content Specialist to help develop, edit, maintain, and modernize educational content for media professionals, educators, students, and enterprise customers worldwide.
This role combines instructional content development, technical editing, software validation, and AI-assisted content creation. The Learning Content Specialist will work closely with product experts, certified instructors, subject matter experts, and internal stakeholders to create engaging learning experiences across Avid 's certification programs, instructor-led training, self-paced learning, and digital learning platforms.
As Avid expands its use of AI-assisted content development, this position will play a critical role in ensuring all content remains accurate, technically sound, instructionally effective, and aligned with real-world workflows. Candidates must be comfortable reviewing AI-generated content, validating procedures within Avid software applications, and refining educational materials to meet Avid Learning's quality standards.
The ideal candidate is passionate about education, media technology, storytelling, and helping others develop professional skills.
Key Responsibilities
Content Development

• Create and maintain educational content for Avid Learning programs

• Develop student guides, instructor guides, assessments, exercises, learning activities, and online training materials

• Translate complex technical concepts into clear, engaging learning experiences

• Collaborate with instructors, product teams, and subject matter experts to develop new courses and certifications

• Contribute to course updates associated with major software releases and new product offerings

Content Editing & Quality Assurance

• Review and edit learning content for clarity, consistency, accuracy, and instructional effectiveness

• Verify software workflows and procedures through hands-on testing

• Validate exercises, assessments, and instructional materials before publication

• Maintain content standards across all Avid Learning offerings

• Identify and correct technical inaccuracies, outdated procedures, and workflow issues

AI-Assisted Content Development

• Utilize AI-powered tools to accelerate content creation and maintenance

• Review, validate, and improve AI-generated instructional content

• Test AI-generated procedures directly within Avid applications to ensure accuracy

• Help establish best practices for responsible and effective use of AI in educational content development

• Continuously improve workflows that combine AI efficiency with human expertise

Learning Platform Support

• Prepare content for deployment within Avid Learning Central and other learning platforms

• Assist with content organization, metadata, accessibility, and learner experience improvements

• Support ongoing content modernization initiatives and certification program enhancements

Collaboration & Innovation

• Work closely with Avid Certified Instructors, Learning Partners, product managers, engineers, and content developers

• Participate in curriculum planning and certification development projects

• Research emerging industry workflows and educational technologies

• Recommend improvements to learning content, assessments, and delivery methods

Preferred Qualifications
Required

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality

• Ability to independently research, verify, and validate technical information

• Experience creating, editing, or maintaining technical, educational, or instructional content

• Strong organizational and project management skills

• Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment

Job Title: Study Start Up Lead - Sponsor dedicated
Job Location: Bucharest, Romania
Job Location Type: Home-based

Job Seniority Level:
The Study Start-Up (SSU) Lead plans and executes global SSU activities to ensure timely trial document and task completion to enable country HA (Health Authorities) and Ethics Committee submissions and site activation to meet ambitious recruitment plans.
The Study Start-Up Lead works collaboratively with other key team members and leads the SSU Team as needed to accelerate study, country, and site activation.
Key accountabilities:
Early Planning and Team Leadership:

• Contributes SSU insights to the development of the trial Operational Execution Plan

• Configures and ensures proper trial-specific set-up of SSU systems

• Prepares global SSU planning and leads SSU Team from kick-off through completion of SSU

• Implements global aspects of protocol and OEP amendments, activates and oversees country implementation of amendments

Global SSU Activation Leadership:

• Ensures global trial templates are ready for country usage, global trial level document collected into eTMF, HA submissions done on time

• Ensures timely global vendor activation

• Directs the Study Grants Expert for investigator grant plan/fair market value assessment initiation and finalization of country site budget and contract template readiness in conjunction with protocol timelines

• Enables country Study Start-up Managers to drive timely start-up activities from country allocation to "Ready to Enroll" within assigned trial

title: Lead Clinical Research Associate
description:
As a Lead Clinical Research Associate, you will hold a leadership role within the study team, overseeing and guiding the clinical team while driving trial activities at a country or regional level. You will ensure high-quality execution, compliance, and timely delivery. You will act as a key point of coordination across cross-functional teams.
This role focuses on leadership, mentorship, oversight, and consistency in monitoring practices rather than direct site management, with minimal to no site assignments and a low-travel model, emphasizing remote oversight and overall study quality.
Responsibilities:

• Monitors project timelines, patient enrollment, data cleaning, and ensuring compliance while implementing respective corrective and preventive measures.

• Reviews monitoring visit reports for all visit types and ensures reporting compliance of the Monitors in the region.

• Acts as the main communication line between Monitor, Site Management Associate, Regional Project Lead, and/ Project Manager.

• Leads project team calls on a country level as well as provides status updates and reports to Regional Lead/ Project Manager.

• Provides project-specific training and prepares training materials for the project team under supervision of a Project Manager and Regional Project Lead.

• Supervises source data verification and follows up on data queries at site level in the country/region; reviews and manages study risks on a site level.

• Ensures proper handling, use, accountability, reconciliation, and return of all Investigational Product(s) and clinical study supplies on a country/region level.

• Reviews essential study documents and supervises reconciliation of study Investigator Site File (ISF) / TMF at site level and country/region level.

• Ensures data integrity and compliance at a site level.

• Collaborates with investigator/ site feasibility and identification process, as well as study startup.

• Manages Monitors in the query resolution process, including Central Monitoring observations.

• Coordinates safety information flow and protocol/process deviation reporting.

• Performs clinical supplies management with vendors on a country and regional level.

• Ensures study-specific and corporate tracking systems are updated in a timely manner.

• Coordinates planning of supervised monitoring visits and conducts the visits.

• Manages the project team in site contracting and payments.

• Ensures ongoing evaluation of data integrity and compliance at a country/regional level.

• Conducts site audit preparation visits, may participate in site audits, and coordinates resolution of site audit findings on a country/regional level.

• Oversees project team in CAPA development and implementation.

• Coordinates project team in process deviations review, management and reporting.

• Conducts initial training and authorization monitoring visits for Monitors and acts as a mentor for newly promoted Lead CRAs.

• Delivers trainings and presentations at Investigator Meetings.

• Ensures that subject recruitment targets and project timelines are properly defined, communicated, recorded, and met at site level.

• Ensures accurate and timely information flow with trial sites on Adverse Events and protocol/process deviations.

• Supervises Site Management Associates in the flow of documents and laboratory supplies between the site and the Central/ Regional Lab/ Central Reviewer.

• Supports preparation of draft regulatory and ethics committee submission packages.

• Relevant educational background, such as MD, MPharm, RN or College/University degree in Life Sciences or an equivalent combination of education, training and experience.

• Minimum of 4 years’ site monitoring experience with participation in global clinical projects as a Lead Monitor or equivalent qualification level.

• Experience monitoring sites in the US.

• Experience with all types of monitoring visits in Phase II and/or III.

• Strong experience in Oncology preferred.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge - navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

 

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

Benefits at Remote is becoming the provider-agnostic, payroll-correct, compliance-monitored infrastructure layer that sits underneath every way Remote employs someone - Employer of Record, global payroll, PEO - and, increasingly, underneath any external HR system a customer brings. It stops being a standalone module people click through and becomes a layer other systems build on top of: invisible when it works, indispensable when it doesn't.

Near term, this is a deeply integration-heavy role. You'll take over a live, high-stakes book of work: migrating benefit costs onto a unified payroll system across multiple carrier and broker paths, standing up retirement plan administration for US global payroll, building provider-agnostic cost ingestion so any customer can bring their own broker or carrier, making benefits data flowing out of clients' own HR systems land correctly in payroll, and resolving benefit-cost data-integrity incidents that touch real employee paychecks. This is hands-in-the-data work: reconciliation logic, eligibility files, settlement thresholds, migration sequencing.

Longer term, this is a full-scope experience and unification role. As Remote consolidates fragmented, product-by-product benefits tooling into one administration platform, one cost-ingestion pipeline, and one source of truth, you'll own the vision and roadmap for making benefits behave consistently everywhere - the same primitives (offers, costs, enrollment, providers, statuses) working the same way across 90+ countries and across Employer of Record, global payroll, PEO, and HRIS-connected customers alike. You'll also own how that layer shows up for non-human consumers - APIs and agent-facing tooling - not just for people in a UI.

This is a senior, high-autonomy role reporting into Product leadership, with regular exposure to Engineering, Payroll Operations, Partnerships, Finance, and Legal/Compliance.

What you bring

• Proven experience as a product manager owning complex third-party integrations (API and file/EDI-based)

• A provider-agnostic mindset: you default to ingesting a customer's existing reality, and anticipating their future needs (their broker, their carrier, their HRIS) rather than forcing them onto a fixed set of embedded partners.

• Proficiency in Cursor and/or Claude Code is required. You must be able to autonomously build, debug, and ship functional code/prototypes, not just write specs.

• Comfort designing for systems as well as humans - you think in APIs and agent-facing tooling, not just dashboards, and can justify a feature by whether it makes a pay run more correct or compliant, not just whether it "feels complete."

In this role, you will take technical ownership of designing, building, and extending mission-critical SAP applications-leveraging modern development paradigms such as the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) and Core Data Services (CDS).

You will drive modern, upgrade-stable SAP development by adhering strictly to "Clean Core" architectural guidelines. Rather than relying on legacy, modification-heavy ABAP patterns, you will build side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP, expose optimized OData services, push heavy calculations down to the in-memory SAP HANA database, and deliver intuitive user experiences via SAP Fiori.

 

What we’re looking for:

 

•
5+ years of SAP development experience, with at least 3 years dedicated to S/4HANA, featuring expert command of Object-Oriented ABAP (OO-ABAP), New ABAP Syntax (7.4+), and RAP (ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model).

•
Advanced proficiency authoring complex Core Data Services (CDS) Views, parameters, associations, access controls (DCL), and ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP) for code push-down performance.

•
Extensive experience creating and exposing OData v2/v4 services via SAP Gateway (SEGW) or RAP business services for UI consumption and third-party cloud integrations.

•
Practical experience developing custom SAP Fiori / SAPUI5 applications or configuring Fiori Elements apps using CDS annotations.

•
Firm understanding of modern SAP extensibility frameworks, including On-Stack Developer Extensibility (Embedded ABAP / Steampunk) and Side-by-Side Extensibility using SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

•
Proven ability to trace, profile, and optimize ABAP/HANA execution using Runtime Analysis (SAT), ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC), SQL Trace (ST05), and SQL Monitor (SQLM).

 

Nice-to-have skills:

 

•
Hands-on experience developing side-by-side extensions on SAP BTP using Node.js/CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model) or ABAP Cloud.

•
Background in legacy-to-S/4HANA code remediation, custom code analysis (CCA), and migration projects.

•
Exposure to Event-Driven Architecture using SAP Event Mesh or Kafka integrations.

•
Knowledge of standard SAP S/4HANA business process modules (FI/CO, SD, MM, or PP).

 

Responsibilities:

 

•
Architect, build, and maintain high-performing transactional and analytical SAP applications using ABAP RAP, CDS views, and AMDP.

•
Build upgrade-stable enhancements and side-by-side extensions, strictly minimizing legacy modifications to protect core system stability.

•
Design and expose secure OData endpoints to power SAP Fiori user interfaces, mobile apps, and enterprise cloud integrations.

•
Perform automated code checks (ATC), enforce clean code standards, conduct peer code reviews, and optimize legacy custom code for S/4HANA compatibility.

•
Collaborate closely with SAP functional consultants, enterprise architects, and BTP specialists to translate business requirements into technical solution specifications.

 

 

What we offer:

 

Get paid, not played

No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments

title: Engineering Manager, Proactive Security - Platform
description:
About the Team
At DoorDash we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery network to support our three-sided marketplace of Consumers, Merchants, and Dashers. Security is paramount to the success of our business, and DoorDash Security aspires to be one the world’s most admired security team. We are committed to building the world's most trusted on-demand, logistics engine for delivery! We're expanding our team of great minds to help us secure and maintain a 24x7, no downtime, global infrastructure system that powers DoorDash’s multi-sided marketplace of Consumers, Merchants, and Dashers.
About the Role
Our Security Engineering team is looking for an Engineering Manager, Proactive Security to set and lead the technical direction for platform hardening at DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo globally.

You will be a part of our inclusive, collaborative global team responsible for building “paved road” Platform Security controls to harden our compute and storage platforms and provide for a safe, secure and resilient delivery network. This is a US or Canada remote position reporting directly to the Director of our Security Engineering team.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Set and execute the technical vision for the Security Engineering Platform team, spanning AWS and GCP account/workload hardening, and vital tier-0 services (Access, Identity, Teleport, HashiCorp Vault, Tokenization and others).

• Influence and drive improvements to engineering standards, leverage advancements and LLMs to improve productivity and velocity.

• Own the hardening roadmap for tier-0 cloud infrastructure and access services, backed by rigorous, follow-the-sun on-call. Success is measured in eliminating classes of misconfiguration and exposure at the platform layer, not in shipping code for its own sake.

• Coach and mentor highly skilled tech leads and engineers as a "player-coach," leaning in at the lowest technical level on cloud hardening, identity, and secrets management problems, and lead the team to build the right durable controls.

• Partner cross-functionally with Core Infrastructure, Compute, Data, and other engineering platform teams to harden the shared cloud and access substrate that all of DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo build on, and deliver bespoke, in-house services where vendored platform controls don't fit.

• Build and maintain high Operational Excellence (OE) practices for tier-0 security platforms with rigorous on-call rotations, clear escalation paths, and minimal downtime, since these systems are load-bearing for every other team's ability to ship and operate safely.

• Drive continuous hardening of AWS and GCP environments so insecure defaults are annihilated and prevented before they ever reach production.

• Influence and enable the secure and responsible adoption of AI tooling and agentic workflows from a platform hardening and access-control perspective.

We’re excited about you because…

• 12+ years of experience as a Security or Infrastructure Platform Engineer at an internet-scale organization, with 3+ years of demonstrated technical leadership leading teams building outcomes at global scale.

• Deep hands-on expertise hardening AWS and/or GCP at scale, including account structure, guardrails, workload and network posture, and golden image pipelines.

• Demonstrated technical leadership operating access and secrets infrastructure such as Teleport, HashiCorp Vault, or equivalent PAM/secrets-management platforms, including the on-call rigor required to run them as tier-0 services.

• Track record of building and running highly available, no-downtime platform services with mature on-call practices, incident response, and root cause analysis.

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Security Engineering, a related field, or equivalent work experience.

• Demonstrated technical leadership designing scalable security platform controls and processes that meet required regulatory requirements.

title: Data Engineer - Remote in Germany
description:
Location: Bremen / Remote in Germany · Full-time
About Synera

Synera builds the AI agent platform that lets hardware engineers connect their tools and automate their workflows. We sell to the world's leading engineering organizations and we run our own company the same way we build our product: automated, data-driven, and AI-first
About the role
We are building an internal superagent : an AI layer over all of Synera 's business data and tools that every employee can delegate work to. Its intelligence is only as good as the data underneath it, and that data foundation is yours to own, build, and shape.
That means the data warehouse, expanded from a GTM reporting store into Synera 's system of insight: GTM data, product telemetry, engineering work, support, finance, and everything in between. It means every connector into it and the interfaces that let agents query it. And it means working with every team to get their data out of heads and meetings and into a form an agent can use. An agent is only as intelligent as the data underneath it. We are looking for a builder.
Who you are:

• SQL is second nature; you have built ETL/data pipelines (Airflow or similar) and data models and are strong in data extraction and transformation.

• You have built the data layer behind LLM applications: retrieval, embeddings and vector search, context design, MCP and comparable tool interfaces. Hands-on evidence beats a course.

• You have integrated multiple systems: APIs, webhooks, auth models, rate limits and unannounced schema changes. You can debug a discrepancy across three tools until you find which definition was wrong, and you think about data access and privacy by default.

• An automator by instinct : scripts, APIs, workflow tools, and AI agents are how you scale yourself. You use LLMs as a daily working tool, not a novelty and the idea of building the data brain behind a company-wide AI agent excites you.

• You have built reporting and forecasting people actually use and know the difference between a dashboard and an answer.

• You work in English confidently; German is a plus. You communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues, sales reps, marketers, and executives alike.

• Ownership mentality: you document what you build, you notice what nobody asked about, and you would rather fix the system than the symptom

Why this role
You will own a whole machine, not a slice of one, with the mandate, the modern stack, and the AI tooling to build leverage instead of backlog. You will lay the data foundation for Synera 's superagent, and you report into Business Operations with a direct line to how the company is run.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Own the data warehouse (Timescale): Synera 's single source of truth for data, it's design and development to always be cutting edge.

• Extract data from our GTM and business systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, product, finance, ...) into our data warehouse reliably, and structure & annotate it so it can be queried.

• Build and own data flows : ETL pipelines (Airflow/Timescale), data models, and the sync jobs that keep systems consistent.

• Turn data into foresight : build the reporting and forecasting layer (Power BI, Salesforce reports, forecast models) that leadership runs on and extrapolate from pipeline, funnel, and usage data to where the business is heading.

• Make the data agent-ready : model and expose it (warehouse models, APIs, MCP connectors, permissions, governance) so AI agents, and ultimately our superagent, can consume it.

• Build the retrieval layer for what is not in tables (documents, wiki content, tickets, meeting transcripts): chunking, embeddings, indexing. Agents working on outdated data give outdated and often wrong answers.

• Engineer, don't improvise : transformations are version-controlled, tested, and documented..

• Treat data quality as a product: monitoring, validation, and hygiene are built in,

• Team enablement: You partner with every team to get their data into the ware

title: Decision Engineering Team Lead, Business Operations
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DECISION TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Automate the delivery of gigawatts. Every process that takes AI infrastructure from land to live compute becomes software: schedules, decisions, and todos generated from a live knowledge graph instead of chased by hand.

- Forward-deploy beside the experts. Product teams sit with quality managers, sourcing leads, and deployment engineers on factory floors and sites, and turn their judgment into systems that reach every unit.

- Deliver every supercomputer faster than the last. Dozens of concurrent projects feed one graph, so every lesson learned at one site becomes a preventive check at all of them.

ROLE SCOPE

- Lead the team that turns business operations into software: two engineers today, five by year end, covering the hiring machine, the cash and capital pipeline, the contract corpus, and the continuous close. Leadership just ranked this work equal to the data center build, and hiring is the company's biggest bottleneck. You own the outcome.

- Own delivery end to end: you set the technical direction, sequence the work with the function's Product Manager, and hold the bar on what ships, and you still write and ship code every week.

- Hire and grow the team from two to five without diluting the bar: engineers who sit with the CFO's team through a close and with recruiters through a loop, and ship systems those teams adopt inside real deadlines.

- Make the architecture calls that keep business operations one graph: people, seats, and loops; purchase orders, contract terms, and cash demand by month; assets from purchase to in service. Four functions feed one model, and you own the boundaries that stop them from becoming four silos.

- Keep the team forward-deployed: your engineers embed with finance, treasury, accounting, legal, and people teams, and you make sure what they build closes the books, releases the capital, and fills the seat, not just the demo.

The platform supports the full logistics lifecycle - from urgent ad-hoc shipments to long-term tenders, and from invoicing and compliance to reporting and analytics. Our customers rely on Cargobase as a system embedded in their day-to-day operations.

Cargobase is entering its next phase of growth, scaling its product ecosystem, modernizing platform architecture, and expanding its global customer base. As customer complexity and commercial ambition increase, execution quality and customer outcomes become business-critical.

The Senior Customer Excellence Manager owns the full post-sales customer lifecycle, with accountability for onboarding, implementation, platform support, ongoing success, and commercial expansion within existing accounts. This role leads a global team of generalist Customer Excellence Consultants and is responsible not only for delivery quality and customer outcomes, but also for retention, expansion readiness, and revenue protection post-sale.

title: Robotics / Hardware Engineer
description: Lumen Labs | Robotics / Hardware Engineer | San Francisco, CA | ONSITE | Full-time | $130k-200k + equity | https://lumenresearch.co I'm Daniel, co-founder. Lumen Labs is building the cognitive layer for physical AI. Nearly every major robotics effort today teaches machines by showing them thousands of hours of human teleoperation. We think that paradigm has a ceiling, and we're working on nature-inspired architectures for unstructured environments (construction sites, mining, pipelines, battlefield). Pre-seed, backed by top VC funds and operators from robotics/AI companies. We're a team of two and hiring teammate #3 to own the hardware and infrastructure that keeps our research platforms running: the ROS2 (Humble) stack across onboard and offboard compute, sensor integration and calibration (LiDAR, depth, IMU, encoders), the safety pipeline during autonomous runs, and getting trained policies onto real hardware. Today that's wheeled navigation; we're dipping our toes into drones and eyeing weirder platforms like pipeline inspection. Where we're at: zero-shot sim2real transfer with a policy that runs at 100Hz on an ESP32 and took under a day to train. You: hands-on with real mobile robots (UART, encoders, PWM, IMU, LiDAR), strong Python + embedded, comfortable reading code you didn't write, and can debug hardware and firmware at the same time. If "full-stack" to you means firmware, a multimeter, and a ROS node in the same afternoon, you'll fit right in. Visa/relocation support for the right person. Full posting: https://desert-bearskin-26d.notion.site/Robotics-Engineer-Ro... Email hi@lumenresearch.co, mention HN, and tell us about a project you've built. If you can link to a time you got a trained policy running on real hardware, you go to the top of the pile.

As a Professional Services Manager II for Axon Air , you will lead the deployment of Axon drone technology for law enforcement, enterprise, and public safety agencies. This elevated role requires advanced technical proficiency, deep program management expertise, and the ability to independently manage complex deployments.

You will serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert (SME) , ensuring customers not only adopt Axon Air solutions but also realize their full potential to transform workflows and enhance organizational effectiveness.
